en: Sasha, congratulations,
that was a lot of fun,
a lot of respect between the two of you.
How high
was the level you both reached tonight?
Yeah, really good.
I think really a step up from the first match
and he played amazing tennis,
incredibly aggressive, served unbelievable,
hit forehands all over the court.
So yeah, definitely happy
to be through in straight sets.
Your forehands had a lot of love this year,
understandably,
but it was the trusty back end
that got it done there at the end.
Well, I think it was just the shot
in that moment, but overall,
I think the heaviness and the speed
of his shots is extremely high,
so it's definitely difficult
to play aggressive yourself,
but I'm happy that I managed in the end.
You had to come off court in the second set.
Can you explain why, are you okay?
I was just sweating,
I was making the whole court wet,
so the umpire told me to go change.
I mean, I was making the court so wet
that it was impossible to play.
Well done tonight.
Thank you.
